page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.26xlarge is a high-density, storage-optimized instance provisioned on KVM hypervisor architecture. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz across 104 dedicated vCPUs. It features 768.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A central hardware feature of the ecs.i3.26xlarge instance is its integrated local SSD storage payload, providing 23,038 GB of attached solid-state storage directly on the host node without requiring standalone external network block storage. In addition to high local storage capacity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The hardware profile does not include GPU acceleration.

The massive local SSD payload paired with substantial RAM capacity makes this instance configured for scale-out distributed databases, high-throughput NoSQL clusters, relational databases requiring low-latency storage access, and large-scale data ingestion pipelines. Its resource balance optimizes local storage density per compute node for IOPS-heavy enterprise applications.
